data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present this beautifully upgraded 4-bedroom villa in Springs 11, offering an exceptional family lifestyle in one of Dubai's most established communities.

Set on a spacious 3,515.06 sq. ft. plot, this extended villa has been fully renovated with high-quality finishes and thoughtfully upgraded to provide maximum comfort and functionality. The home features bright, open living spaces, a modern layout, and a professionally landscaped garden, making it ideal for families seeking a move-in-ready residence.

Property Details:

• 4 Bedrooms
• 3 Bathrooms
• Maid's Room
• Plot Size: 3,515.06 Sq. Ft.
• Extended Layout
• Fully Renovated and Upgraded
• Brand-New AC Units and Ducting
• Renovated Maid's Room
• Guest Bathroom with Shower
• Custom Built-in Cabinets and Storage
• Built-in Safe
• Professionally Landscaped Garden
• Palm and Olive Trees
• Automatic Irrigation System
• Smart Home System
• Security Cameras
• WiFi Gate Control

Community Amenities:

• Swimming Pools
• Parks and Green Spaces
• Children's Play Areas
• Basketball and Tennis Courts
• Walking and Cycling Trails
• 24/7 Gated Security
• Nearby Schools and Retail Centers

Springs 11 is a highly sought-after family community offering a peaceful environment, excellent connectivity, and easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road, schools, shopping destinations, and everyday conveniences.
